rejected_assumptions: Seven open source repositories in rPNKWE4GrWA remain individually unidentified; do not invent them.
A video's free setup guide is not free inference, free compute, free SaaS quotas or permitted video/image rights.
No external app automatically gets owner passwords or platform authorization.
A new skill file alone does not install a model or make a host persistent.
source_recommendations: Schedule only real recurring jobs; do not leave GitHub runners alive as servers.
Reuse existing trusted agent memory, evaluation, context files and skills before adding an agent manager.
Keep an independent reviewer separate from the creator; record corrections and unresolved founder tasks.
For local software use free source packages only when a lawful accessible compute runtime exists.
